suggestions.assertion: Each tech stack layer gives a Recommendation, a Why/rationale, and at least one Alternative
suggestions.reason: Run-3's Security layer provides Recommendation+Why but no labeled Alternative (reasonable, since security controls are not 'pick one of'). The assertion would benefit from clarifying that Alternatives are expected only for layers where a real alternative choice exists (the OUTPUT_FORMAT reference says 'Omit layers that genuinely don't apply'). As written it is borderline for Security; graded pass because all genuine choice-layers carry alternatives.

suggestions.reason: Verifiable only weakly from the output file (no transcript/tool log provided). Passes via librarian suggestions, but absence of a persistence attempt is not directly observable without a transcript.

eval_feedback.overall: All assertions satisfied with substantive content. Run-3 takes a meaningfully different design stance (Stripe Billing as system-of-record, firm BullMQ/Redis) yet still passes every assertion, confirming the assertions are robust to legitimate architectural variation.
